definition: a house, the family in which is issueless.
example_en: That family remained issueless, an heirless household.

definition: the act of robbing a person or a place by force; plunder.
example_en: The robbers carried out plunder in the village.

definition: a long-established custom or practice; a tradition.
example: ಈ ಹಬ್ಬ ಹಳೆಯ ಪುರಾವೃತ್ತದಿಂದ ಆಚರಣೆಗೆ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: This festival has come into practice from an old tradition.

definition: the quality or the manner that captivates the mind by fascination.
example_en: There was a captivating charm in that singer's voice.

definition: a short knob of hair.
example: ಮಗುವಿನ ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ತುಂಡುಗೂದಲು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a short knob of hair on the child's head.

definition: prime youth.
example_en: In her prime youth, her beauty stood out.

definition: a speaking with legal or moral authority; an authoritative pronouncement or command.
example_en: The chief minister's authoritative pronouncement reached all the districts.

definition: a good advice; a wise counsel.
example_en: The teacher's good advice showed the way to life.

definition: an animal or plant with the sexual organs of both the male and the female; a hemaphrodite.
example: ಆ ಹೋಟೆ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯನ್ನು ಜನರು ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯದಿಂದ ನೋಡಿದರು.
example_en: People watched the hermaphrodite animal with astonishment.

definition: pertaining to the foot or stepping.
example: ಅವಳ ಪಾವಿ ಮುದ್ರೆ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಮೂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Her foot-related mark had formed on the mud.

definition: the profession of a trader; business; trade.
example: ಅವನ ಮನೆತನ ಹಲವು ತಲೆಮಾರುಗಳಿಂದ ವಣಿಜ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಡಗಿದೆ.
example_en: His family has been engaged in trade for many generations.

definition: the quality or fact of moving to and fro continuously; a being unsteady, shaky, a quivering; a flickering.
example_en: The flickering of the lamp increased further in the wind.

definition: (hist.) a tax paid by smiths for using the anvil.
example_en: In the past, blacksmiths used to pay the anvil tax to the king.

definition: the act of crossing over (as a stream, river, etc.).
example_en: Crossing the river was dangerous.

definition: any violent disturbance, as a social upheaval.
example_en: A violent disturbance occurred in the village during the election.

definition: a false or baseless accusation.
example_en: It was proved to be merely a false accusation.

definition: to restrict; to restrain (something or someone); to control.
example_en: He restrained his anger and became calm.

definition: the act of intervening; intervention.
example_en: It is not right to intervene in others' matters.

definition: a place where tents, huts, barracks or other more or less temporary structures have been put up for soldiers; a camp.
example_en: The British army's camp was in that open field.

definition: the act of audible weeping.
example_en: The child's audible weeping was heard throughout the house.

definition: collectively, jewels and money.
example_en: For the wedding she wore all her jewels and money.

definition: to establish or settle oneself permanently or for a long time, at a place or in a position.
example: ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ನಂತರ ಅವರು ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲೆಗೊಂಡರು.
example_en: After many years of travel, they settled permanently in that town.

definition: to separate solid contents from a liquid by filtering; to filter.
example_en: She filtered the milk through a cloth.

definition: a kind of necklace having round beads.
example_en: She wore the round-beaded necklace around her neck.

definition: delicately suggestive; not grossly obvious; subtle.
example_en: Everyone liked her subtle humour.

definition: the quality or condition of being milky white.
example: ಆ ಹೂವಿನ ಕ್ಷೀರಗೌರತ್ವ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The milky whiteness of that flower drew everyone's attention.

definition: the plant Tylophora indica (= Asclepias asthmatica) of Asclepiadaceae family; vomiting swallow.
example_en: The doctor recommended nepala leaves for the cough.

definition: a kind of brass instrument with a loud tone; a trumpet.
example_en: The soldiers blew the trumpet and prepared for battle.

definition: any of small, brightly colored, tropical passerine birds, of Nectariniidae family, somewhat resembling the hummingbirds; a sunbird.
example_en: A sunbird was drinking nectar from the flowers in the garden.

definition: to grow stronger or become more resolute.
example_en: Even amid difficulties, he grew stronger and more resolute.

definition: Mahābhārata, which is considered as an additional Veda.
example_en: Elders revere the Mahabharata as the fifth Veda.

definition: an electric discharge with lightning and thunder; a thunderbolt.
example_en: A thunderbolt suddenly struck in the sky.

definition: the crane Leptoptilus dubius; adjutant crane.
example_en: The adjutant crane was catching fish on the riverbank.

definition: a rough, hard abrasive stone for shaping gems.
example_en: The goldsmith polished the gem with the rough abrasive stone.

definition: white colour.
example_en: She was wearing a white saree.

definition: to cover the body with.
example_en: She lay down covering her body with a shawl.

definition: that which is tied, bound, fastened.
example_en: The knot of the rope became loose.

definition: a small wave.
example_en: A small wave rose on the pond.

definition: freedom from danger, suffering or calamity.
example_en: By the grace of God he attained freedom from danger.

definition: interchange; exchange i.e. a) the act of giving or taking one thing in return for another; b) the act or process of substituting one thing for another; c) something given, offered or received in an exchange.
example: ಎರಡು ದೇಶಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸರಕುಗಳ ಅದಲಾಬದಲು ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: An exchange of goods took place between the two countries.

definition: blood, as a red liquid.
example_en: Blood flowed from the wounded hand.

definition: to cause (two or more things) to join; to associate.
example_en: The two coaches were joined together.

definition: a written decree or order of an authoritarian ruler.
example_en: The king's written decree was announced to the whole kingdom.

definition: to sink downward by weight or pressure; to become smaller; to shrink.
example_en: The mat sank down because of the excess weight.

definition: the state of being impossible; impossibility.
example_en: Everyone realized the impossibility of that plan.

definition: the act of a processing proceeding to a certain point and coming back to the starting point.
example: ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕರು ಆ ಜಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರಗಂಚಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿದರು.
example_en: The travellers went up to that place and came back.

definition: a sub caste, the members of which are very traditional folk song singers and devotees of 'Maṇṭesvāmi'; 2.a male member of this caste.
example: ಜಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ನೀಲಗಾರ ಮಂಟೇಸ್ವಾಮಿಯ ಹಾಡು ಹಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: At the fair, a Nīlagāra singer sang a song of Maṇṭesvāmi.

definition: faultless; untainted.
example: ಅವನ ನಡತೆ ಅಖಾರಿ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೊಗಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone praised his conduct as faultless.

definition: an uncivilised man; a savage; a barbarian.
example: ಆ ಬಬ್ಬರ ಊರಿನ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That barbarian struck fear in the people of the village.

definition: the tree Symplocos racemosa of Symplocaceae family.
example_en: The bark of the Symplocos racemosa tree is used as medicine.

definition: to be destroyed or spoiled.
example_en: The crop was spoiled without rain.

definition: a cart, coach that is not covered at the top.
example_en: They set out to the village sitting in an open cart.

definition: a spindle - a) a pin in a spinning wheel used for twisting and winding the thread; b) a small bar with tapered ends used for the same purpose in hand-spinning; c) a pin bearing the bobbin of a spinning machine.
example_en: The weaver wound the thread on the spindle.

definition: to present betel nut and leaves (as a formal mark of sending off).
example_en: The elders said to present betel nut and leaves to the guest as a formal send-off.

definition: either of the two flaps on a bridle that keep the horse from seeing to the sides; a blinker.
example: ಕುದುರೆಗೆ ಕಣ್ಣುಪಟ್ಟಿ ಹಾಕಿ ಪಕ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ನೋಡದಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They put blinkers on the horse so it could not see to the sides.

definition: a settling in life with a secured livelihood.
example_en: He has now settled into a secured livelihood.

definition: a kind of shield that is almost flat.
example_en: The soldier was holding the flat shield in his hand.

definition: afterwards; subsequently.
example: ಸಭೆ ಮುಗಿದು ಬಳಿಕ್ಕ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮನೆಗೆ ತೆರಳಿದರು.
example_en: After the meeting ended, everyone went home afterwards.

definition: a breach (as in a fort) used as a secret passage by a certain person or persons either to get into or run away.
example: ಕಳ್ಳರು ಚೋರ್ಗಂಡಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಕೋಟೆಯಿಂದ ಪಲಾಯನ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The thieves escaped from the fort through the secret passage.

definition: in, at or to a higher place; overhead; up; above.
example_en: The birds were flying above.

definition: a sour liquid consisting of dilute and impure acetic acid, obtained by acetous fermentation from wine, used as a condiment, preservative, etc.; vinegar.
example_en: They mixed a little vinegar into the salad.

definition: name of a female demon wife of Bhīma, in Mahābhārata.
example_en: Hidimbe later became Bhima's wife.

definition: to tie around.
example_en: She had the flower garland tied around her neck.

definition: a feeling of discontent and ill will because of another's advantages, possessions, etc.; resentful dislike of another who has something that one desires; envy.
example: ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನ ಹೊಸ ಮನೆಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಅವಳ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕರುಂಬು ಮೂಡಿತು.
example_en: Seeing her friend's new house, envy arose in her mind.

definition: musical recitation of poems or a poetical work.
example_en: The poet's musical recitation of the poem enthralled everyone at the gathering.

definition: to remove the husk or husks from; to husk; to hull.
example_en: She husked the paddy and separated the rice.

definition: abundance; plentifulness.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾನ್ಯದ ಪ್ರಾಬಲ್ಯ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Everyone knew about the abundance of grain in that village.

definition: a thing that has actually happened or that is really true; fact.
example_en: Everything he said turned out to be a fact.

definition: a piece of land that remains uncultivated.
example_en: He grew cotton on the uncultivated piece of land.

definition: (a flower bud) to unfold (the petals) and to expand.
example_en: The flower's petals unfolded at dawn.

definition: the way in which something is made or done; manner; fashion.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಈ ಫ್ಯಾಷನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This fashion is popular everywhere this year.

definition: a low, whispering speech.
example_en: The teacher heard the children's low whispering speech.

definition: loud noise.
example_en: A loud noise of vehicles was heard on the street.

definition: to take out long yarn or thread as from cotton, wool, silk, etc.
example_en: He was doing the work of drawing out thread from silk.

definition: a one-celled, microscopic organism belonging to any of several families of rhizopods that move and feed using pseudopodia and reproduce by fission; amoeba.
example_en: An amoeba can be seen only through a microscope.

definition: to predict the future events (said of the people community buḍubuḍike).
example_en: The fortune-teller went from street to street predicting future events.

definition: an invitation for a dinner or a feast.
example: ಗೆಳೆಯನ ಮನೆಗೆ ಔತನ ಬಂದಿತ್ತು, ಆದರೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಲಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: An invitation to a feast had come from his friend's house, but he could not go.

definition: a man who is hereditarily working as a slave.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಬಳಿದೊತ್ತು ತಲೆಮಾರುಗಳಿಂದ ಸೇವೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The hereditary slave of that house had served for generations.

definition: a man fostered by another (other than his parents).
example: ಆ ಬಾಲಕ ಚಿಕ್ಕಪ್ಪನ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪರೈಧಿತನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದನು.
example_en: That boy grew up fostered in his uncle's house.

definition: the pea plant Vicia hirusta ( = Ervum hirsutum) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The mangalyaka vine had spread over that garden.

definition: a stroke; a blow.
example_en: The blow of his hand struck the chest.

definition: to buy and sell; to traffic in; to trade.
example_en: He trades in cloth in the town.

definition: a stormy, turbulent or very noise condition (as created by unruly mob); commotion.
example_en: A turbulent commotion arose in the market due to the crowd.

definition: great brightness; lustre; brilliance; effulgence.
example_en: The brilliance of the sun lit up the entire sky.

definition: a sticky, colloidal carbohydrate found in certain trees and plants, which dissolves in water and used as or in making adhesive; a gum.
example_en: The gum oozing from the tree is used as adhesive.

definition: to join, unite (two or more things together).
example_en: He joined the two ropes together by knotting them.

definition: that which is proper, appropriate.
example_en: One must show conduct that is appropriate to this occasion.

definition: to have sexual intercourse.
example_en: The story makes a reference to the two of them having sexual intercourse.

definition: the cardamom plant Amomum subulatum of Zingiberaceae family; large cardamom.
example_en: The aroma of large cardamom spread in the kitchen.

definition: to weave together; to interlace; to interweave.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಬಿದಿರಿನ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮೆಡಱಿ ಬುಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother interwove bamboo strips and made a basket.

definition: a rail-road.
example_en: The train departed from the station right on time.

definition: to be possible or workable (for a person).
example_en: This work is not workable for him.

definition: a variety of onion plant;(details ?).
example_en: They were selling that variety of onion in the shop.

definition: the act of treading, stepping or walking on.
example: ಅವನ ಮೆಟ್ಟು ಶಬ್ದ ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಕೇಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The sound of his treading was heard in front of the house.

definition: to have a limit, restriction, etc.
example: ಈ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ಒಂದು ವರ್ಷ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸೀಮೆದಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This agreement has a limit of only one year.

definition: entered in; that has come in.
example_en: This new member has already entered in.

definition: the act of swallowing, engulfing; an instance of this.
example_en: I was frightened by the snake's swallowing.

definition: the quality or fact of not being permanent; impermanence; transience.
example: ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಅನಿತ್ಯತೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವಳು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: She always spoke about the impermanence of wealth.

definition: the leguminous tree Tamarindus indica of Caesalpiniaceae family; tamarind.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹುಣಸಿ ಹಣ್ಣನ್ನು ನೆನೆಸಿ ರಸ ತೆಗೆದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother soaked the tamarind fruit and extracted the juice.

definition: a payment or fee exacted by the state, the local authorities, etc., for passage along a road or entry into a town, territory, etc.; a toll.
example_en: At the border, the merchants paid a toll for the goods.

definition: having a hump (like a bull); humped.
example_en: The humped bull was walking slowly.

definition: an irritation in the skin; itch.
example: ಕೈಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಲ್ಲೆ ಆಗಿ ತುರಿಕೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: An itch developed on the hand causing irritation.

definition: the hard framework of an animal body, supporting the tissues and protecting the organs; esp. all the bones collectively or the bony framework, of a human being or other vertebrate animal ; the skeleton.
example_en: The doctor showed the skeleton to the students.

definition: an elaborate meal; feast; a banquet.
example: ಮದುವೆಯ ದಿನ ಊರವರಿಗೆಲ್ಲ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬಿದ್ದು ಏರ್ಪಡಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: On the wedding day, they arranged a grand feast for the whole village.

definition: a screen (curtain) hanging down.
example_en: A hanging screen dangled from the window.

definition: a feigning to be what one is not, with an intention to deceive or in trying to get a favourable impression of oneself from, others.
example_en: He deceived people by putting on a false show.

definition: the condition of being prepared in advance; preparation; readiness.
example_en: The advance preparation for the function is already complete.

definition: (a hole) to be bored.
example_en: That part of the wall got bored (with a hole) due to water.

definition: to be captured, seized; to be apprehended.
example_en: The thief was seized and captured by the police.

definition: a sudden, plentiful and forceful outflow; stream; gush.
example_en: A gush of water was flowing from the rock.

definition: the gaseous envelope (air) surrounding the earth; atmosphere.
example_en: The atmosphere has been spoiled by pollution.

definition: the plant, Prunus domestica of Rosaceae family.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಲೆಬಕೋರಾ ಗಿಡ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The ālebakōrā plant grows well in this region.

definition: a young leaf (in gen.).
example: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದ ನಂತರ ಮರದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಗುರೆಲೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: After the rain, a young leaf appeared on the tree.

definition: (astrol.) a school of astrology that considers the movement of the sun as the base for astrological calculation.
example: ಪುರಾತನ ಪಂಡಿತರು ರವಿಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The ancient scholars calculated according to the ravi siddhānta school of astrology.

definition: a fighting between two persons, using daggers as weapons to fight with.
example_en: A dagger fight took place between two warriors.

definition: a single thing.
example: ಅವಳು ಒಂದು ಬಿಡಿ ಹೂವನ್ನು ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She held a single flower in her hand.

definition: that is made applicable to all in general; generalised.
example: ಈ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಸಾಧಾರಣೀಕೃತ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕಟವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The solution to this problem was published in a generalised form.

definition: to move from a higher to a lower place; to come or go down; to land.
example_en: He slowly came down from the hill.

definition: an engineer who constructs, plans to construct a road, path, bridge, etc.; a road-engineer.
example_en: The road-engineer designed the plan for the new bridge.

definition: any of various wolflike carnivores (family Hyaenidae), with powerful jaws, a bristly mane, short hind legs, and a characteristic shrill cry, fed on carrion; a hyena.
example_en: The hyena was hiding near the stream.

definition: the evergreen ornamental tree Saraca indica of Caesalpiniaceae family.
example_en: A Saraca indica tree has grown in the courtyard.

definition: a beautiful place.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಆ ಎಡ್ಡತಾಣ ನೋಡಲು ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That beautiful place on the hill was lovely to see.

definition: to make (some one) sympathetic, tender; to cause to yield to sentimental appeal.
example_en: That speech made the audience sympathetic and tender.

definition: the western direction.
example_en: The sun sets in the western direction.

definition: the actual or imaginary path taken by a celestial body during its periodic revolution around another body; the orbit of a planet.
example_en: The scientists measured the shape of that planet's orbit.

definition: a hostile attitude caused by intense dislike; a feeling of enmity; hostility.
example_en: Hostility was growing in his mind.

definition: a man who stitches (clothes); a tailor.
example_en: I got clothes stitched at the tailor's shop.

definition: a hog, that roots up the earth.
example: ಭೂದಾರ ಎಂಬ ಹೆಸರು ಹಂದಿಗೆ ಸಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ, ಅದು ಮಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಕೆದಕುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The name bhūdāra suits the hog, for it roots up the earth.

definition: the quality or fact of taking all matters into consideration objectively while judging something; an all-covering mental attitude.
example_en: A judge must have an all-covering, objective outlook.

definition: to become pleasing, interesting strikingly effective in appearance; to become colourful.
example_en: The rangoli became colourful and looked beautiful.

definition: the state of being possessed by the excessive desire for sexual intercourse.
example_en: Excessive sexual desire disturbed his mind.

definition: the act of stopping.
example_en: The stopping of the rain has not yet happened.

definition: the ownership or the rights of ownership.
example_en: The ownership rights of that land belong to him.

definition: a man who tends donkies.
example_en: The donkey tender takes the donkeys out to graze every day.

definition: the essence of knowledge.
example_en: The essence of knowledge is briefly explained in that book.

definition: the quality of being foolish; foolishness.
example_en: Everyone laughed at his foolishness.

definition: being very much like (another) in appearance or nature.
example_en: His gait was very much like his father's.

definition: the fifth one in a consecutive series.
example: ಈ ಪಂಕ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಪಂಚಮ ಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: In this row he stands in the fifth position.

definition: a defensive heavy beam used by the vanguard against sword or spear attack.
example_en: The soldiers used the defensive beam in the vanguard.

definition: freeing from the moral, religious corruportion or sinfulness.
example: ಆ ದೇವರ ಪತಿತಪಾವನ ಗುಣವನ್ನು ಭಕ್ತರು ಸ್ಮರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Devotees remember that god's quality of freeing the fallen from sin.

definition: a kind of kite (a variety ?).
example_en: The boys were flying a gunāhaddu kite in the sky.

definition: heredity - a) the transmission of characteristics from parent to offspring by means of genes in the chromosomes; b) the tendency of offspring to resemble parents or ancestors through such transmission.
example: ಅನುವಂಶೀಯತೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಹೆತ್ತವರ ಗುಣಗಳು ಬರುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: Through heredity, children acquire the traits of their parents.

definition: at once; immediately; without prior notice.
example_en: He left the house at once without notice.

definition: (masc.) an ardent devotee; a sincerely dedicated man.
example: ಆ ಪರಿಕಾಂಕ್ಷಿತನು ಗುರುಗಳ ಸೇವೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ಜೀವನ ಕಳೆದನು.
example_en: That ardent devotee spent his life in the service of the guru.

definition: the quality that attracts the mind; such a state; attractiveness; beauty.
example: ಆ ಹೂವಿನ ಚೊಕ್ಕಳ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮನಸೋತರು.
example_en: Everyone was captivated by the beauty of that flower.

definition: anything that covers; a cover.
example_en: A colourful cover was put on the furniture.

definition: to cause or allow (something) to become loose, slack.
example_en: He slowly loosened the rope.

definition: a mechanical apparatus for doing some specific work, with less manual labour; a machine.
example: ಹೊಸ ಮಿಶಿನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The new machine does more work in less time.

definition: the tree Sapindus emarginatus of Sapindaceae tree; soapnut tree.
example: ಹಿಂದೆ ಜನ ಅರುಟಾಲದ ಬೀಜದಿಂದ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಒಗೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In the past, people washed clothes using the seed of the soapnut tree.

definition: a stick carried when walking, as a support; a walking-stick.
example_en: The old man leaned on his walking stick and walked slowly.

definition: a woman who indulges in sexual relations with a man not married or with several men for pleasure or money.
example_en: People in the town talked about that promiscuous woman.

definition: (pl.) the five expedients used in politics.
example_en: The five political expedients must be used wisely in politics.

definition: a sound that is deafeningly heavy.
example_en: The deafeningly heavy sound of the explosion made the ears go deaf.

definition: a domesticated cow.
example_en: A domesticated cow was tied in the house's courtyard.

definition: a living together hormoniously without hostility.
example_en: The people were living together in harmony.

definition: to pick up; to take up one by one (from a lot).
example: ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಕಾಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಅವಳು ಪೆಱುಕಿದಳು.
example_en: She picked up one by one the grains fallen on the ground.

definition: the lark Mirafra cantillans of Alaudidae family, smaller in size than house sparrow, with light bown body, light brown wings with dark brown spots, dull white breast, white brow, short, somewhat forked tail, brown legs and bill, that nests on the ground; singing bush-lark.
example_en: The singing bush-lark was sitting near the field and singing.

definition: a term used to express fraternal relationship or spirit.
example: ನನ್ನ ಭಾವು ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: My brother-in-law (brother-like friend) comes to our house every year.

definition: the part of the body enclosed by the ribs, breastbone, and diaphragm; the chest.
example: ಓಟದ ನಂತರ ಅವನ ಛಾತಿ ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಏರಿಳಿಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the run, his chest was heaving rapidly.

definition: the handle of a sword or dagger.
example_en: The handle of that dagger was adorned with gold.

definition: a preconceived idea or opinion.
example: ಅವನ ಸಾಚೀಕೃತ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಂಶಯ ಮೂಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His preconceived opinion raised doubt about everyone.

definition: the act of making a short snapping sound with the thumb and middle finger.
example: ಅವನ ಕೈಚಿಟಿಕೆ ಶಬ್ದ ಕೇಳಿ ನಾಯಿ ಓಡಿ ಬಂತು.
example_en: Hearing the sound of his finger-snap, the dog came running.

definition: (pl.) the acts of loading goods into and unloading from a ship; the general transactions involving sending to, and getting from another country or other countries goods on commercial terms; export and import.
example_en: Loading and unloading always goes on at the port.

definition: the act of praising; praise; commendation; laudation.
example: ಜನರು ದೇವರ ನುತಿ ಹಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಮೆರವಣಿಗೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: People sang praises of god and took part in the procession.

definition: the act of crying aloud; the act of announcing widely.
example_en: The government made an announcement of the new scheme.

definition: to cause to become dusty.
example_en: The wind blew and made the whole room dusty.

definition: to play a musical instrument.
example_en: He played the veena on the stage.

definition: a field where some crop is raised.
example_en: The farmer grew paddy in the field.

definition: to disturb, spoil the condition or state of being.
example_en: His lie disturbed the whole plan.

definition: an opening made by or as by cleaving; a crack; a crevice; a cleft.
example: ಬಂಡೆಯ ಇಡಂಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಹಾವು ಅಡಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A small snake was hiding in the crevice of the rock.

definition: a bead of glass.
example_en: She wore a necklace of glass beads around her neck.

definition: another or a different caste, group, class, etc.
example_en: He married a girl of a different caste.

definition: a musical mode.
example_en: That singer sang in the musical mode Nagadhvani.

definition: a chaplet or a list of titles.
example_en: The chaplet of titles adorned the king's neck.

definition: a cutting of the fold of skin that covers the glans of the penis as a religious rite, as of the jews or muslims; circumcision.
example: ಆ ಸಮುದಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಡು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಸುಂತಿ ಮಾಡಿಸುವುದು ಪದ್ಧತಿ.
example_en: In that community, it is customary to have circumcision performed on male children.

definition: one who is subordinate to another subordinate officer.
example_en: That subordinate officer obeyed the senior officer's order.

definition: the quality of being immaculately clean.
example_en: The immaculate cleanliness of the house earned everyone's praise.

definition: to hold or seize with the hand.
example_en: Before falling, she grabbed hold of the pillar.

definition: a call or summons to engage in a duel, contest, as of skill, strength, etc.; a challenge.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರು ಪೈಲ್ವಾನರ ನಡುವೆ ಕುಸ್ತಿಗೆ ಮುಡಿಗೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A challenge for a wrestling match took place between the two wrestlers.

definition: the chief clerk who supervises other clerkś works.
example_en: The chief clerk supervised the work of all the clerks.

definition: the quality of being short; shortness.
example_en: The shortness of this article pleased the readers.

definition: a metal chain or fetters.
example_en: They tied a chain around the dog's neck.

definition: to handle, touch or foster lovingly, affectionately or tenderly; to caress; to fondle.
example_en: The mother fondled the child lovingly.

definition: reputation based on one's good character, behaviour, compassion, clemency, empathy, etc.
example: ಆಕೆಯ ಸೇವೆಯಿಂದಾಗಿ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ದೊಡ್ಡಿತೆ ಹೆಸರಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Because of her service, she had a good reputation in the village.

definition: the characteristic vocal sound made by a cat.
example_en: The cat said 'meow' near the door.

definition: a walking with firm, heavy but steady steps.
example_en: The soldier crossed the ground with a firm, manly gait.

definition: to spread (oneself) over a wide area.
example_en: The army spread itself over the whole plain.

definition: a particular strategic movement in wrestling.
example_en: He used the wrestling hold konakasa well in the bout.

definition: a man who is seeking or has sought shelter or protection.
example_en: That man seeking shelter took refuge in the temple.

definition: the eleventh of the twenty seven lunar mansions, containing two stars (Zosma and Theta Leo).
example_en: They said marriage under the Pubbe lunar mansion is not auspicious.

definition: a very stingy, miserly man.
example: ಆ ಜೀನಹಂಕ ತನ್ನ ಬಂಧುಗಳಿಗೂ ಒಂದು ಪೈಸೆ ಕೊಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That very stingy man does not give even a penny to his own relatives.

definition: the act or state of moving rapidly; swiftness; quick motion.
example_en: The birds flew swiftly across the sky.

definition: (dial.) a small, round cake made of bengal gram, spices, by frying in oil.
example_en: Mother made hot fried gram cakes for us.

definition: to be kept in order; to regularise; to make suitable.
example_en: He arranged all the belongings in order.

definition: to move (a thing) against something else or move (things) over each other with pressure and friction, as to make the former become powder; to rub.
example: ಅವನು ಗಂಧದ ಕೊರಡನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ತೆಯ್ದನು.
example_en: He rubbed the sandalwood log on the stone.

definition: a morsel of food.
example_en: To the hungry, even a single morsel of food is nectar.

definition: (the skin) to become thick and hardened; to become callous.
example_en: The old farmer's feet had become thick and hardened.

definition: to batter a person mercilessly.
example_en: The wicked men battered that person mercilessly.

definition: small, detatchable dagger attached to the front part of the barrel of a rifle; a bayonet.
example_en: The soldier attached the bayonet to the rifle.

definition: (one's identification) to become known; to be recognised; to be identified.
example_en: The thief's identity became known.

definition: an unchaste, promiscuous woman.
example_en: He developed a relationship with a promiscuous woman.

definition: to bite one's moustache in anger; to express one's anger.
example_en: Hearing his words, the grandfather bit his moustache in anger.

definition: a long rattan cane with hangers on either side to carry burden on the shoulder or back of the neck.
example_en: The labourer carried the bundle of firewood on the carrying-pole.

definition: the tree Sesbania paludosa of Papilonaceae family.
example_en: The shade under the sesbania tree was cool.

definition: young ears of corn.
example_en: The farmer held the young ears of corn in his hand and looked at them.

definition: the condition of a man getting married before his elder brother.
example: ಆ ಮನೆತನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿವೇದನ ನಡೆಯಬಾರದೆಂಬ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: In that family there was a custom against a younger brother marrying before the elder.

definition: the tree Aquilaria agallocha (Agallochum aloe) of Thymelaeaceae family.
example_en: The wood of the agilu tree has a pleasant fragrance.

definition: a woman belonging to potterś caste; a female potter.
example_en: That female potter makes clay pots.

definition: a fine-grained earth.
example_en: The potter used fine-grained clay for the pots.

definition: to go or flow toward.
example_en: The devotees went toward the temple.

definition: a device for seizing or lifting objects, having two long arms pivoted or hinged together; a pair of tongs.
example_en: The carpenter pulled out the nail using the tongs.

definition: a civil administrative officer empower to administer the law; a magistrate.
example_en: The magistrate imposed a punishment on the accused.

definition: a dancing to the rhythm of drum-beatings.
example_en: Everyone danced to the drum-beats at the fair.

definition: intentional perversion of truth in order to induce another to part with something of value or to surrender a legal right; an act of deceiving or misrepresenting.
example_en: Many people were deceived by his fraud.

definition: a leg that is injured or having disability.
example_en: He suffered a disabled leg in the accident.

definition: to go under the surface of a liquid; to plunge oneself into water.
example_en: He plunged into the depth of the river.

definition: an earthen pot for melting metals; a crucible.
example_en: The goldsmith melted the gold in the crucible.

definition: to become less (in size, severity, intensity, etc.).
example_en: After taking the medicine, the pain became less.

definition: a pillar that supports (something) from below.
example_en: A supporting pillar was the base for that old house.

definition: a battle or combat.
example_en: Many warriors died in that battle.

definition: a strong feeling of displeasure and belligerence aroused by a wrong; anger; ire.
example_en: Anger arose in his mind because of the injustice.

definition: waste material; debris, refuse, litter; rubbish.
example_en: A heap of rubbish had piled up in front of the house.

definition: a very young child; a baby; an infant.
example_en: The newborn baby was born today.

definition: a pregnant woman.
example_en: The whole family took special care of the pregnant woman.

definition: the large-sized, evergreen tree Cedrus libani of Coniferae family; Indian cedar.
example_en: The bhadraka is a tall evergreen tree.

definition: observation or examination of the outside objects (opp. to introspection).
example: ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿ ಬಹಿರ್ದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯ ವಿದ್ಯಮಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The scientist studied natural phenomena through outward observation.

definition: a piece of coral, esp. the red kind used in jewelry; coral.
example_en: A rare piece of coral had been set into that ornament.

definition: an elder sister.
example_en: The elder sister spoke kind words to her younger brother.

definition: every year; annually.
example_en: This festival is celebrated every year.

definition: moral judgement that opposes the violation of a ethical principle and that leads to feelings of guilt if one violates such a principle; conscience.
example: ಅವನ ಮನಃಸಾಕ್ಷಿ ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನನ್ನು ಚುಚ್ಚುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His conscience was pricking him about the wrong he had done.

definition: boastful talk.
example_en: Everyone laughed hearing his boastful talk.

definition: to go out of sight; to disappear.
example_en: The bird flapped its wings and disappeared into the sky.

definition: to lay (something) upside down or facing downward; to overturn.
example_en: He laid the cup upside down on the table.

definition: along with; together with.
example_en: He went to the market along with his younger brother.

definition: the act of walking; walking.
example_en: Walking every day is good for health.

definition: a damage to or an offence against, onēs esteem, dignity or status etc.
example_en: That remark caused a damage to his self-esteem.

definition: the act of adorning, decorating ornamenting; beautifucation.
example_en: The devotees were mesmerized by the decoration of the temple.

definition: the quality or state of being sublime, majestic, noble etc.; sublimity; nobility.
example_en: The nobility of that monument astonished the onlookers.

definition: the effect of a heavy stroke, collision; shock.
example_en: He felt the shock of the collision against the wall.

definition: the quantity in excess; that much which is greater than the limit, desirable level, etc.; excess.
example_en: There is a little excess in the measurement.

definition: the state of being disorder, deranged, confused.
example: ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೋಳಾಗೋಳಿ ನಡೆದು ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಮಾತನಾಡಲು ಆಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Such disorder arose in the meeting that no one could speak.

definition: height - a) the distance from bottom to the top of something standing upright; b) the extent of elevation above a level.
example_en: The height of that tree was very tall.

definition: a disease of the spleen.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಗುಲ್ಮಶೂಲೆ ಇರುವುದಾಗಿ ಪತ್ತೆ ಹಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor diagnosed him with a disease of the spleen.

definition: to detect, perceive or get a suspicion of by or as by sniffing: to sniff out.
example_en: The dog sniffed out the thief's scent.

definition: anything worn to adorn, decorate the body; an ornament.
example_en: She wore silver ornaments for the wedding.

definition: an iron rod.
example_en: The construction worker measured the wall with an iron rod.

definition: the male Indian antelope, Antelope cervicapra.
example_en: A male Indian antelope ran swiftly through the forest.

definition: ancient time.
example_en: People of ancient times led a simple life.

definition: (pl.) different kinds of things (considered together).
example_en: Various different kinds of goods are available in that shop.

definition: to spread all over; to diffuse.
example_en: The fragrance spread all over the entire room.

definition: (sing.) any of several microscopic creatures making up a division of microorganisms which are typically one-celled, have no chlorophyll, multiply by simple division some of which cause diseases such as pneumonia and anthrax, while others are necessary for fermentation, nitrogen fixation, etc.; bacterium.
example_en: Bacteria cause many diseases.

definition: one's wife's or husbanḍs younger brother.
example_en: The younger brother-in-law bought clothes for that festival.

definition: the initial stage of winter season.
example_en: The cold increases in the initial stage of winter.

definition: a variety of horse.
example_en: They kept the jada breed of horse in the king's stable.

definition: a kind of herb.
example_en: The herb called kunjige grows in the forest.

definition: (gen. pronounced with the vowel 'a') the forty third letter of Kannaḍa alphabet and the twenty ninth consonant.
example: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವ ಎಂಬ ಅಕ್ಷರ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The letter 'va' occurs in the Kannada alphabet.

definition: to have hopes or favourable expectation.
example_en: She had favourable expectations for the exam result.

definition: a wandering.
example_en: His life passed away in mere wandering.

definition: a male sheep.
example_en: A ram fight took place at the fair.

definition: to defend or guard from injury, damage, loss, annoyance, etc.; to protect.
example_en: God always protects his devotees.

definition: the quality or fact of being thick.
example_en: This wall has sufficient thickness.

definition: the selling or buying of goods in relatively large quantities and usu. at lower prices than at retail; wholesale.
example_en: This market is famous for wholesale trade.

definition: the general things of a house.
example_en: They have kept the household things in a box.

definition: the hem or end of a dhōti or a sari tucked into the waist-band.
example_en: He tucked the hem of the dhoti into his waist-band.

definition: a man having profound knowledge and intelligence; a learned person or scholar.
example: ಧಿಷಣನ ಮಾತನ್ನು ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಜನರು ಗೌರವದಿಂದ ಕೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers listened with respect to the words of the learned scholar.

definition: relating to a religious sacrifice or sacrifices or performance of a sacrifice; sacrificial.
example_en: The priests conducted the worship according to the sacrificial procedure.

definition: a small (black) board to write on.
example_en: The teacher wrote the sum on the small writing board.

definition: a place affording protection, as from the elements or danger; a shelter.
example_en: He looked for a shelter to escape the rain.

definition: the general life span of people in a country.
example: ವರದಿಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಆ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಅಯುಃಪರಿಮಿತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: According to the report, the life expectancy of that region has decreased.

definition: a net which opens when thrown used to catch birds, animals, etc.
example_en: The hunter threw the casting net and caught the bird.

definition: the act of revenging; retaliation for injuries or wrongs; vengeance; revenge.
example_en: He took revenge on the enemy.

definition: a wide inlet of a water body indenting the shoreline or the adjacent land.
example_en: Ships were anchored inside the sea's wide inlet.

definition: a kind of resonant bugle.
example_en: The sound of the resonant bugle rang out during the festival.

definition: (bot.) rolled inward and in the margins; involute.
example_en: The edges of this leaf are rolled inward, involute.

definition: a three-legged stool of low height; a tripod.
example_en: There was a low three-legged stool in the village house.

definition: a small vessel for travel on water, propelled by an oar or oars.
example_en: He crossed the river in a small rowing boat.

definition: looked at; seen; observed.
example_en: His behaviour was observed by everyone.

definition: a refined, cultured man.
example: ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಸುಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೊಗಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone praised him as a refined, cultured man.

definition: renunciation of worldly attachments, sensual enjoyments etc. for religious purpose.
example_en: He embraced renunciation and departed for the forest.

definition: a wailing cry, as of grief, pain or despair.
example: ಆ ಹೆಂಗಸಿನ ಗೋಗರೆತ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನ ಕಲಕಿತು.
example_en: That woman's wailing cry moved everyone's heart.

definition: the tree Musa superba of Musaceae family.
example_en: The Musa superba tree has grown tall in the garden.

definition: to make the soft, long sounds of cuckoos.
example_en: The cuckoo was making its soft long sounds on the tree.

definition: (pl.) the length and breadth.
example_en: He measured and wrote down the length and breadth of the table.

definition: to shout aloud; to roar.
example_en: The soldiers roared aloud on the battlefield.

definition: fondness; affection; liking.
example: ತಾಯಿಗೆ ಮಗುವಿನ ಮೇಲಿನ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿಕೆ ಎಂದೂ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The mother's fondness for the child never diminished.

definition: the fact or quality of being human; human nature; humanity.
example_en: Helping others in difficulty is humanity itself.

definition: a shrunken neck.
example: ಅವನ ಗುಜ್ಜಗೊರಲು ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಅಯ್ಯೋ ಎಂದರು.
example_en: Seeing his shrunken neck, everyone said 'oh no'.

definition: to inflict with a superficial wound.
example_en: The tip of the knife inflicted a superficial wound on his hand.

definition: empty or worthless talk.
example: ಅವನ ಬಗುಳೆ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನು ಯಾರೂ ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Nobody took his empty talk seriously.

definition: the ornamental, gold or silver border of a diadem.
example_en: The ornamental border of the king's diadem shone with gold.

definition: (dial.) the act or process of ejecting the contents of the stomach through the mouth; vomit.
example_en: After the vomiting, he felt a little better.

definition: a superior variety of rice.
example_en: The cook used raajabhoga rice for the festival.

definition: not obstructed, controlled, restricted by another or others.
example_en: That work got finished as though unobstructed by anyone.

definition: suppressed, but potent anger.
example: ಆ ಅನ್ಯಾಯದಿಂದ ಅವಳ ಎದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಧುಸುಮುಸು ಕುದಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Suppressed anger boiled in her heart due to that injustice.

definition: the agave Agave americana of Agavaceae family.
example_en: The leaves of the Agave americana grew very large.

definition: to cause to repair a dent or dents in a surface.
example_en: He got the car's dented door repaired at the garage.

definition: (the eye) to become red.
example_en: His eyes became red with anger.

definition: a disorder of the muscles of the eyes, as cross-eye, in which both eyes cannot be focused on the same point at the same time.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗನಿಗೆ ಉರುಗಣ್ಣು ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಅವನು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನೋಡಲಾರನು.
example_en: Because that boy has cross-eye, he cannot see properly.

definition: (a cow, buffalo, etc.) to let the milk flow of the udder.
example_en: The cow is standing, letting the milk flow from its udder.

definition: the act or an instance of going up; an escalating; a rise; a soar.
example_en: The rise in prices troubled the common people.

definition: a rare variety of beryl that is coloured green by chromium and valued as a gem; emerald.
example_en: An emerald was shining in that ring.

definition: a mountain (that has a peak).
example_en: That mountain with a peak was hidden amid the clouds.

definition: he who sees, observes or examines.
example_en: As an observer of the stars, he stayed awake all night.

definition: (the throat) to get blocked and hence become unable to make distinct or clear sound.
example_en: Because of the cold his throat got blocked and he could not speak clearly.

definition: something arranged in a definite pattern of organization; a structure.
example_en: The organizational structure of the office files is very clear.

definition: the largest, vegetarian, intelligent anthropoid apes, Gorilla gorilla; gorilla; to snore.
example_en: The gorilla eats leaves in the forest.

definition: to scold, reprove strongly.
example_en: The father scolded his son for lying.

definition: to be sleepy or half-asleep; to drowse.
example_en: In the middle of the lecture he began to doze off.

definition: to give, allow an interval of time between two points of time.
example: ಎರಡು ಸಭೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ತಡವುಗೊಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He asked that a short interval be given between the two meetings.

definition: the disposition of a person who cheats, deceives another or others.
example: ಅವನ ಪುಯ್ವಗೆ ತಿಳಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಎಚ್ಚರಗೊಂಡರು.
example_en: After learning of his deceitful nature, everyone became cautious.

definition: a kind of medicinal substance made using zinc oxide.
example_en: The doctor told the patient to consume the zinc-oxide medicine.

definition: (attached things, coupling, etc.) to be separated; to become unfastened.
example_en: The parts of the old machine came unfastened.

definition: (said of the state of the mind) not changing, fickle or wavering.
example_en: The yogi's mind was settled in a steady, unwavering state.

definition: any of various large crows; esp., the largest crow (Corvus corax), with a straight, sharp beak; a jungle-crow; a raven.
example_en: A raven was perched at the top of the tree.

definition: a particular kind of stitch .
example_en: This particular kind of stitch has been used in this saree.

definition: of or forming a foundation or basis; basic; essential; fundamental.
example_en: Honesty is a fundamental element for a good life.

definition: a heavy, club-like staff.
example_en: The guard had a heavy club-like staff in his hand.

definition: the quality or fact of requiring complete compliance or exact performance; enforcement of rigidity; inflexibility; strictness, harsh, punctiliousness; austerity; sternness.
example_en: The strictness of discipline in the school was very harsh.

definition: an open porch or portico, usu. roofed, along the outside of a building; a verandah.
example_en: The children were playing in the verandah of the house.

definition: a length of rope made twisting three or more cords.
example_en: The farmer tied the ox with a triple-twisted rope.

definition: extent from side to side; breadth; width.
example_en: The width of that river was very great.

definition: a sari (a garment worn by Indian women, consisting of a long piece of cotton or silk wrapped around the body with one end draped over the head or over one shoulder), having flower-designs on it.
example: ಅವಳು ಹೂಬಣ್ಣದ ಸೀರೆಯನ್ನು ಉಟ್ಟು ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದಳು.
example_en: She wore a flower-designed sari and went to the festival.

definition: a difficult or troublesome condition; trouble.
example: ಸಾಲ ತೀರಿಸುವ ತಿಗಲು ಅವನನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ಕಾಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The trouble of repaying the debt had greatly worried him.

definition: a woman who has just been married or is about to be married; a bride.
example_en: They brought the bride to the wedding pavilion.

definition: a servant in a formal official uniform.
example_en: The uniformed servant changed the guard in the evening.

definition: a payment back or refunding of (money taken).
example_en: The borrower agreed to make the repayment.

definition: a tract abounding in reeds.
example_en: Birds were sitting in the reed-covered tract around the lake.

definition: a man who sells perfumes.
example_en: The perfume seller was selling sandal sticks.

definition: a sword held in the hand.
example_en: The warrior raised the sword in his hand and faced the enemy.

definition: the condition of being disabled; disability.
example_en: The accident caused him permanent disability.

definition: to set a counter attack.
example_en: When the enemies advanced, the soldiers set a counter attack.

definition: lack of politenes, civility.
example_en: The lack of civility was evident in his words.

definition: cleaned; cleansed; washed; clean; pure; clear.
example_en: She washed the clothes clean.

definition: a senseless, useless talk.
example_en: Nobody understood his senseless talk.

definition: the common stinging nettle Urtica dioca of Urticaceae family.
example_en: A common stinging nettle plant has grown by the side of the path.

definition: a hand weapon having a long, sharp-pointed blade, usu. with a sharp edge on one or both sides, set in a hilt; a sword.
example_en: The soldier drew the sword from its sheath.

definition: that which has an iron ring or cup at one or both the ends; a pestle.
example_en: They pounded the grain using a pestle with an iron ring.

definition: a joining together of two or more things, persons in a right and comfortable manner.
example: ಆ ಎರಡು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಬೆಸಗೆ ಮದುವೆಯಿಂದ ಬೆಸೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The bond between those two families was joined through marriage.

definition: the top, flat surface of a building; terrace.
example_en: They dried the clothes on the terrace of the house.

definition: the wife of one's maternal uncle.
example_en: My maternal uncle's wife has come home for the festival.

definition: (Jain.) Indra, the king of Heavens.
example_en: In Jain legends, Kalpēśvara is called Indra.
